title: Deployment references an image tag that does not exist

root_cause.summary: The image tag ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:99.99.99 does not exist, so the kubelet cannot pull it (ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff).

required_evidence: Container waiting reason is ErrImagePull or ImagePullBackOff
Pod events report that the image tag was not found / manifest unknown
red_herrings: The registry is public; this is not an authentication or imagePullSecret problem
Other podinfo pods in the namespace pull the same image repository successfully
fix: Correct the image tag to one that exists (for example 6.7.1) and roll out again.
